newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street stocks seen higher in early trade.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street stocks seen higher in early trade.

text.p: Wall Street stocks were expected to bounce after Wednesday's sell-off and move higher in early trading as investors continue to focus on fourth quarter earnings reports.
Among the companies that the market will focus on was Sun Microsystems Inc, which was up one at 29-1/4 in London after reporting earnings after Wednesday's close.
"Sun Micro and Digital Equipment came in above expectations and the market will celebrate that," said Larry Wachtel, analyst at Prudential Securities.
